tools.name: search_clinics
tools.description: Search configured clinics by name, city, area, or specialty to get their clinic ID, short code, address, and booking URL.

tools.name: get_clinic_details
tools.description: Retrieve full clinic details including doctors, specialties, consultation fees, opening hours, address, Google Maps link, and FAQs.

tools.name: book_clinic_appointment
tools.description: Submit a patient appointment request directly to the clinic's staff portal. Always confirm patient name, phone number, and preferred time within clinic hours before calling.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "book_clinic_appointment" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Submit a patient appointment request directly to the clinic's staff portal. Always confirm patient name, phone number, and preferred time within clinic hours be…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_clinics · Public sink: book_clinic_appointment.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_clinics · Public sink: book_clinic_appointment

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
